Verification2.1 compares diagonal and off-diagonal coefficients, using epsilon(x)=1 to force exactly one surviving coefficient; it also verifies each such vector and excludes group-likes in the empty set coalgebra. boundaries.evidence: Steps 1.1 and 2.1 use only finite sums over the given finite set.

Verification1.1 and2.1 check Delta(e_g)=e_g tensor e_g and epsilon(e_g)=1 for every g. Thus each listed basis vector is grouplike, completing the reverse direction of the Example classification.

finite_checks.claim: For G={a,b} and x=αe_a+βe_b, impose Δ(x)=x⊗x and ε(x)=1.
finite_checks.result: Coefficient comparison gives α²=α, β²=β, αβ=0, and α+β=1; the only solutions are (α,β)=(1,0) and (0,1), matching step 2.1.

Verification1.2 forces b=0 and a=1 for a grouplike ag+bx, while2.1 proves g-primitives have a=0 and conversely verifies every bx, without any multiplication on C. Verification step 1.1 supplies the grouplike equations for g. Verification step 2.1 computes Delta(bx)=bx tensor g+g tensor bx and epsilon(bx)=0 for every scalar b, including b=0, proving sufficiency in the relative-primitive classification.
